caseNameFull: Smith v. Sielaff, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 918.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that J. Lloyd Snook III, Esquire, of Charlottesville, Va., be appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.
